scope: Isolated compiled-source browser acceptance with synthetic localhost backend; not a live deployment

results.name: Empty selection, running-agent exclusion and clear selection
Filtered select-all and filter changes never retain hidden targets
Context filtering bounds the exact confirmation target list
Cancel and Escape make zero deletion requests
Confirmed targets use raw API IDs exactly once; unselected agents remain
Live refresh never expands an existing selection
Confirmation is bound to an immutable target snapshot
Partial success reports failures and retries only retained failed targets
Network errors and null responses are not reported as successful deletion
A refreshed running agent is removed from selection
List checkbox Space handling and mixed select-all state preserve navigation
Manage agents selects only the labeled page and resets on page change
Switching views clears selection before returning to Manage agents
Delayed predelete map responses cannot resurrect confirmed-deleted agents
